producer_judgment.rationale: Both endpoints are Class X Content Domain Specific Learning Outcomes (same statement grain) in Chapter 12 – Electricity under Content Domain 'How things work', so the comparison is within-grain and at identical canonical rank (Class X, rank 1). CLO80 is an investigative/experimental outcome (planning and conducting experiments to verify Ohm's law, series/parallel resistance effects, heating effect of current) inheriting from LO3 (plans and conducts investigations), while CLO84 is a representational-convention outcome (using the convention that conventional current direction is opposite to electron flow) inheriting from LO9 (uses scientific conventions). They cohere substantively around electric current in the same chapter — correctly applying current-direction conventions supports interpreting circuit experiments, and experimental work reinforces the convention — but neither statement's evidence shows that proficiency in one is developmentally needed for or extends into the other, and the same-rank coordinate provides no directional basis. Token/trigram and page-proximity signals are weak and mainly stopword-driven, so symmetric conceptual coherence is the supported judgment rather than a directed build. Note that both endpoints' source evidence is truncated and the LO9 parent carries a same_code_different_content audit flag, limiting how firmly the parent-outcome framing can be read.
